audit.whatIsWrong: The stored chart gave Cassiopeia levels 1 and 2 while the page's own whys[0] opens 'You have the level 1 edge' and whys[1] says the level-2 windows 'roughly cancel out'. Levels 4-5 and first item were marked Skill against a packet that gives both to Cassiopeia.
audit.why: packet.levelChart = [Renekton, Skill, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia]. The packet agrees with the prose at every row; the stored chart did not.
audit.corrected: phases[0], phases[1], phases[3] and phases[5] flipped with win[0], win[1], win[3] and win[5] as one atomic group, ratings adjusted, and the four phase whys rewritten so each states why that side owns the stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Miasma is the tracked cooldown on every screen of this page and its actual duration was never given.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s — the longest cooldown in her kit and by far the widest entry window Renekton gets. Twin Fang is 0.75s and Cull the Meek is a flat 7s, which is the real reason the poke loop out-paces the heal.
audit.corrected: The 24s rank-1 figure is now in winCon, phases[3].why, phases[5].why and dontsFull[1].d; the 0.75s / 7s comparison is in whys[3].

audit.why: The two decisive interactions are already stated and stated correctly: Miasma grounds the return Slice and Dice (Riot's text says grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities, so the derived flag is supported here), and Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing her, which is why the side-approach advice in spikes[2] and mid is right. Nothing needed changing.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere, in a lane whose losing pattern is her healing off you.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags 'needs-antiheal': Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt and fires every 0.75s against a poisoned target, so extended trades refund her faster than Cull the Meek refunds you.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now buys Executioner's Calling and names Twin Fang as the reason.
sources: enemyKit E text and heal flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Cassiopeia is referred to as 'he'/'his'/'him' throughout, including the TL;DR the player reads on the loading screen.
audit.why: Presentation error that undermines trust in the rest of the page.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tldr, winCon, report[0], report[1], report[2], report[3], report[11], tradeGood, breakdown.trading and the donts. Several untouched strings still carry it, listed in notes.

notes: The level chart on disk contradicted the page's own opening line — whys[0] says 'You have the level 1 edge' while the chart handed level 1 to Cassiopeia. Corrected to the packet chart as one atomic group. Miasma's grounding claim is genuine here: Riot's own text says grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities, so the derived flag is supported and the return-dash advice stands. Petrifying Gaze stunning only enemies facing her is likewise correct as written and is the strongest content on the page. Cassiopeia is called 'he' in several strings I did not otherwise touch — breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, report[4], report[12] — worth a sweep.
